Metric function is_extension_installed (vscode.py:200-210) correctly handles rules parameter with type='not_contain'
Command will execute correctly since 'shell': true is present in result config (line 68), enabling the pipe operator
Minor precision note: grep could theoretically match 'README.md.bak' or similar files, but setup only creates 'README.md' so this is not a practical issue
